DDL	CREATE DATABASE showdb
SESSION	USE showdb
DDL	CREATE TABLE showcolumn1 (col1 int, `col 2` int) USING json
DDL	CREATE TABLE showcolumn2 (price int, qty int, year int, month int) USING parquet partitioned by (year, month)
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW showColumn3 (col3 int, `col 4` int) USING json
DDL	CREATE GLOBAL TEMP VIEW showColumn4 AS SELECT 1 as col1, 'abc' as `col 5`
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showcolumn1
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showdb.showcolumn1
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showcolumn1 FROM showdb
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showcolumn2 IN showdb
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN badtable FROM showdb
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showdb.showcolumn1 from SHOWDB
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showdb.showcolumn1 FROM baddb
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showcolumn3
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showdb.showcolumn3
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showcolumn3 FROM showdb
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showcolumn4
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN global_temp.showcolumn4
READ	SHOW COLUMNS IN showcolumn4 FROM global_temp
DDL	DROP TABLE showcolumn1
DDL	DROP TABLE showColumn2
SESSION	DROP VIEW  showcolumn3
DDL	DROP VIEW  global_temp.showcolumn4
SESSION	use default
DDL	DROP DATABASE showdb
